newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel frees PLO policeman seized in Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel frees PLO policeman seized in Gaza.

text.p: Israeli troops on Friday freed a Palestinian policeman they seized in the Gaza Strip on suspicion he was firing at them, the army said.
A military statement said it turned out the policeman was firing at a fleeing suspect.
At the time of the incident on Thursday, a Palestinian official said the policeman was pursuing a suspected Palestinian smuggler who fired several shots in the air.
No one was injured in the incident along a road separating the Palestinian town of Khan Younis and Gush Katif settlement.
Israel handed over most of the Gaza Strip to Palestinian rule in 1994 under a peace deal with the PLO. Israeli soldiers still patrol around Jewish settlements and on main roads.
"An Israeli army investigation determined that the Palestinian policeman was in pursuit of a Palestinian and opened fire close to an Israeli army force," the army said on Friday.
It said the Israeli force acted properly under the circumstances. It said the policeman was returned to his unit.
